name: product-pricing
title: Product pricing
description: The site's product pricing section. receipt (the site's): the head, the free note and two buttons beside a receipt of three records at the rate, the free row and the total in credits with what is left of the free month; open: the rate set large beside what is free; plans: what each plan buys at the rate; rate: the rate alone in a ruled card.
use_for: The pricing section of a product page, with the product's own rate and records.
never: A total that does not add up: the item counts it from the rate and the rows
Prices other than the plans you sell
source: Site pages/Products/ProductPricing, ProductPricingReceipt, ProductPricingOpen, ProductPricingPlans (and their CSS modules, ProductPricing.content.ts): the receipt on --raised with --radius-m, 16px in (32 from 768), rows ruled by --line with 48px pictures (64 from 768) 4:5, the total under --line-strong in h5 (h4 from 768); copy 5fr to 7fr from 1024 with 64px between (96 at 1280); the rate in h1-alt, display-s at 768 and display-l at 1024
body:
The receipt counts its total from `value` (the leading number, one credit by default) times the rows, and what is left
from `freeMonthly`. A row without `picture` shows a neutral block; the free row without one shows the empty frame with a
plus. `plans` reads the leading number of each plan's `credits` to say how many records it buys, and shows `after`
when there is none.

Each row's `picture` takes a src or an image slot; the neutral block and the free row's empty frame carry
`data-ds-placeholder`.

examples.name: Receipt
examples.label: Receipt
examples.content:
<!-- The site's receipt for Creator search: three Acme creators at one credit each and the free row. -->
<spyglass-product-pricing prefix="creator-search" value="1 credit" unit="per creator found" product="Creator search" rows='[{"name":"Acme Fit","meta":"@acmefit"},{"name":"Acme Run","meta":"@acmerun"},{"name":"Acme Yoga","meta":"@acmeyoga"}]' free='{"name":"Add a missing creator","meta":"Indexed automatically"}' tally="3 creators found"></spyglass-product-pricing>

examples.name: Open
examples.label: What is free
examples.content:
<!-- The rate set large beside what is free. -->
<spyglass-product-pricing variant="open" prefix="creator-search" value="1 credit" unit="per creator found" example="Find 20 creators, use 20 credits." free-rows='[{"label":"500 credits a month, no card","value":"Free"},{"label":"Adding a missing brand or creator","value":"Free"},{"label":"Looking up product categories","value":"Free"},{"label":"The API and the MCP server","value":"One pool"}]'></spyglass-product-pricing>

examples.name: Plans
examples.label: What each plan buys
examples.content:
<!-- What each plan buys at one credit per creator. -->
<spyglass-product-pricing variant="plans" prefix="creator-search" value="1 credit" unit="per creator found" noun="creators" plans='[{"name":"Free","price":"$0","unit":"a month","credits":"500 credits a month"},{"name":"Creator","price":"$10","unit":"a month","credits":"5,000 credits a month"},{"name":"Pro","price":"$20","unit":"minimum a month","credits":"$1.50 per 1K credits","after":"Pay as you go"},{"name":"Enterprise","price":"Custom","credits":"Volume pricing","after":"Volume pricing"}]'></spyglass-product-pricing>
